paragraphs: The TB pack shall support authorised symptom screening, relevant history, optional eligible AI assistance, referral preparation and follow-up of testing or care milestones. Screening output shall remain separate from confirmed diagnosis and official programme registration.
Acceptance: A low-risk AI output cannot suppress a referral required by the approved symptom protocol, and an unresolved result remains visible for follow-up.
BR-PROG-07  Protocol change and case continuity  (Must, R1)
Pack changes shall have an effective date, affected population, change summary and transition rule for open cases. Historical actions shall retain the rules in force when they occurred.
Acceptance: Updating a referral rule identifies affected open work and requires reviewed migration rather than silently rewriting past decisions.

The platform shall support later packs for immunisation, child health, diabetes or other buyer-approved needs using the same configuration and review process. Their adoption is subject to workflow and integration readiness.
Acceptance: A new pack can reuse common identity and observations while defining independent schedules, role boundaries and destination rules.
